title: HH-60 Search and Rescue Helicopter
description: An HH-60 Search and Rescue helicopter lands on USS Makin Island Oct. 4. The helicopter is part of a Special Marine Air Ground Task Force with the 11th Marine Expeditionary Force which is the first amphibious landing force to embark the Makin Island, which set sail for San Francisco, to participate in the city’s 2010 Fleet Week. There the 11th MEU plans to showcase to the public the Marine Corps’ men and women, its aircraft and equipment and its ability to conduct missions that span the overlapping spectrums of peace and combat, from disaster relief to war. Produced by Sgt. Jason W. Fudge.
keywords: Fleet Week, Jason Fudge, SMAGTF, 11 MEU, HH-60 Search Rescue, Marines, USS Makin Island, San Francisco
